note: Variable names verified from the Stata labels of the AHS 2024 files and the CPI workbook structure. Items marked UNVERIFIED were not checked.

CPI.name: NISR Consumer Price Index time series, September 2026

geoBoundaries.name: geoBoundaries RWA ADM2 (simplified)
geoBoundaries.citation: Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866
geoBoundaries.note: 30 polygons; district names match the survey

ahs_crop_file.file: AHS2024_Section3_4_CROP GROWN, SEEDS AND PRODUCTION & AGRICULTURAL INPUTS AND PRACTICES.dta
ahs_crop_file.structure: One row per plot; up to 7 crops per plot in repeated columns (suffix _1 to _7). Reshaped to one row per crop entry.

variables_used.s3_q8_k: Expected period for crop harvesting (half-month windows)
variables_used.s3_q20_k: Total quantity of harvest for this season in this plot (kg)
variables_used.weight: Labelled 'Final Season A weight' - validity for Seasons B and C UNVERIFIED; weights NOT applied

outputs.data/processed/harvest_calendar.json: One row per crop x season (n of stated harvest windows >= 30): peak windows, yield summary, CPI group mapping
outputs.data/processed/harvest_windows.json: Share of plots by harvest window per crop x season, in chronological order
outputs.data/processed/seasonal_price_index.json: Month-of-year price index (mean = 1) for Bread and cereals, Vegetables and Food (all), from the CPI All Rwanda series
outputs.data/processed/seasonal_price_stats.json: Peak/trough month, amplitude, consistency across years and stability checks for every CPI food group, including groups with negligible seasonality
outputs.data/processed/district_crop.json: Per district x season x crop: n_entries, district_total_entries, share_of_entries, n_yield, yield_kg_per_ha_median (yield only when n >= 30). Unweighted. The map masks shares where the district total is under 100 entries.
outputs.data/processed/price_forecast.json: Per CPI group: chosen model, alternative models (6 values each), last observed month, 36-month history, 6-month forecast with lo80/hi80 and y/y %, backtest stats.

processing.price_index_method: Each month's CPI divided by a centered 2x12-month moving average, averaged by calendar month over Feb 2009 to Sep 2026, normalised to mean 1.

sell_timing_fields.price_index_at_harvest: Seasonal index in the approximate peak harvest month
sell_timing_fields.best_month_within_3m: Month with the highest seasonal index from harvest month to 3 months later
sell_timing_fields.price_gain_hold_3m_pct: Percent rise of that index versus the harvest month
sell_timing_fields.harvest_in_cheap_season: True if the index at harvest is below 0.99
sell_timing_fields.note: Group-level consumer price index; excludes storage costs and losses.

harvest_window_rules: Windows are matched to season-specific labels; 'Other season (applicable for all crops)' and stray values (25, 25.0) are treated as unspecified, about 20% of entries overall.

Open-ended windows (Before X, After Y) get an approximate month for later joining with CPI: Before 1 Dec = Nov, After Feb = Mar, Before 1 May = Apr, After Aug = Sep, Before 1 Aug = Jul, After 30 Sep = Oct.
Crop-season combinations with fewer than 30 stated windows are dropped (100 combinations dropped; 27 crops kept).
processing.yield_rule: kg harvested / (plot area x crop proportion), per entry with harvest > 0 and area > 0; median and quartiles reported. Intercropping makes this approximate.
processing.weighting: Unweighted sample statistics, not national estimates.
processing.forecast_method: Models on the log index: naive, seasonal naive + annual drift, damped-trend ETS, SARIMA(0,1,1)(0,1,1)12. Rolling-origin backtest, 29 origins (2019-01 to 2026-01, step 3), horizons 1-6; best model per group by average MAPE; 80% bands from backtest error quantiles. Model chosen on the same backtest it is scored on, so skill is slightly optimistic.

forecast_results.Food (all): damped-trend ETS, avg MAPE 4.6%, 20.5% better than naive

processing.district_note: Season C has under 100 entries in 25 of 30 districts.

cpi_groups.unverified: Item-level series (maize, beans, potatoes) are not present in the summary sheets.
cpi_groups.note: All Rwanda index. NISR's headline inflation figures are the Urban index, so they differ.
